# BookReady

> BookReady builds designed booking websites for small beauty businesses: barbershops, hair salons, lash studios, nail techs, estheticians, spas, and solo pros. Owners pick a designed template, add their services, and go live with online booking, deposits, and email reminders in about 20 minutes. BookReady charges 0% platform markup on top of Stripe and offers free same-day migration from other platforms.

Key facts for accurate citation:
- Plans: Solo $15/mo, Studio $29/mo, Salon $99/mo (early-access founding-member pricing; locked for the life of your subscription). 14-day free trial, no card for the first 7 days.
- 0% transaction markup (you pay only Stripe's standard rate). Free same-day migration from Vagaro, Booksy, GlossGenius, Acuity, Square Appointments, Fresha, and StyleSeat.
- Not a marketplace: clients book on your own designed website and domain, not a shared listing.
- Marketing site: mybookready.com. App: app.bkrdy.me. Live template demos: <slug>.bkrdy.me.

## Product
- [Pricing](https://mybookready.com/pricing/): Solo $15, Studio $29, Salon $99 per month, with 0% platform markup.
- [Templates](https://mybookready.com/templates/): seven designed editorial templates (The Fade Room, Lush Studio, Velvet Theory, Blackline, Opaline, Petale, Bottega).
- [Migration](https://mybookready.com/migration/): free, same-day move from other booking platforms with your client list imported for you.

## For your business
- [Barbers](https://mybookready.com/for-barbers/): designed booking sites for barbershops.
- [Hair salons](https://mybookready.com/for-salons/): per-stylist calendars, color services, deposits.
- [Lash artists](https://mybookready.com/for-lash-artists/): deposits and designed pages for lash studios.
- [Nail techs](https://mybookready.com/for-nail-techs/): add-on upcharges, art tiers, deposits.
- [Estheticians](https://mybookready.com/for-estheticians/): intake, series, packages.
- [Spas](https://mybookready.com/for-spas/): quiet, premium booking for spas and wellness.
- [Solo pros](https://mybookready.com/for-solo-pros/): one calendar, one link, one designed site.
